description: This file defines a struct TestBufferWriterStruct that implements buffer writing interfaces, providing methods for advancing, getting memory and span, and producing a read-only sequence for testing buffer writing functionality within Orleans.Serialization.TestKit.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the write position by the specified number of bytes.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> starting from the current write position with an optional size hint.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> starting from the current write position with the specified size hint.

methods.name: GetReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Creates a ReadOnlySequence<byte> from the buffer up to the number of bytes written, segmented with batching.
